preconditions.description: The jumble must be a string.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(dictionary, list) and all(isinstance(word, str) for word in dictionary)
preconditions.description: The dictionary must be a list of strings.

postconditions.expression: all(word in dictionary for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: All words in the output must be present in the dictionary.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(word) == sorted(jumble) for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: All words in the output must be anagrams of the jumble.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [word for word in dictionary if sorted(word) == sorted(jumble)]
postconditions.description: The output must contain all anagrams of the jumble found in the dictionary, in the same order as the dictionary.
